atoms.b: Darkness is the ((++absence presence)) of light.
Why is space dark when the Sun is so bright?
Although the Sun is a ((++light_source light_sauce)), there is ((++nothing everything)) in space to light up, so it appears dark.
Then why isn’t the sky dark too?
Unlike space, the sky is not empty. The sky contains ((++air rock)) particles, which are illuminated when the Sun’s light rays hit them.
